card.name: Digits inside ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: Mainly a digit inside an ISBN or a word-count figure in reference text. It also fires weakly on scattered words just before family-related phrases.

modes.label: Digits in ISBNs
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of an ISBN in a book citation.

modes.label: Words before family mentions
modes.description: A linking word just before text about relatives or the effect on loved ones.

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese and English words for family members, spouse and loved ones, so it mainly steers away from family terms.
card.plain: It fires on digits inside book ID numbers and, more weakly, on words just before a mention of family.
